name: California State Bar Number (SBN)
description: Detects California State Bar Numbers in SBN format (6-7 digits). California lawyers are identified in public records by their SBN — exposure allows lookup of the attorney's name, firm, and discipline history, which in turn can identify the client matter. Elevated severity under Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 6068(e)(1): counsel identity is a quasi-identifier that contributes to matter re-identification.

metadata.pattern_note: SBN format: 6-7 digits, always preceded by 'SBN', 'State Bar No.', or 'Cal. Bar No.' context cue. California bar numbers are 6 digits (pre-2000 admissions) or 7 digits (post-2000). Higher severity than the US baseline rule because CA's full-anonymization standard treats counsel identity as a quasi-identifier.

effect.message: California State Bar Number tokenized — SBN enables public lookup of attorney identity, which can re-identify the client matter under Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 6068(e)(1)
